body:
Slice 3 of #4277. Depends on the reconcile diff.

## Why

Sync must be **user-driven**. Nothing reconciles automatically — not on connect, not on a timer. Connecting a token (or detecting drift on an already-connected project) raises a banner; the user reviews and confirms.

`useGithubConnect.finishConnect` (`useGithubConnect.ts:85-100`) stays as-is — it does not gain a sync call. Connecting only makes drift *checkable*.

## Shape — reuse the existing precedent

`StoreParityBanner` (`AppBanners.tsx:646`) is already exactly this pattern: a `Banner variant="bar" tone="warn"` with a **Review** toggle that expands an `app-banner-detail` list, dismissable. `SeedDriftBanner` (`AppBanners.tsx:694`) adds the confirmed action plus a result summary. Build on those rather than a new surface.

```
+--------------------------------------------------------------------+
|  12 issues differ between this plan and GitHub.     [Review]  [x]   |
+--------------------------------------------------------------------+
   v Review
   Completed here - would close on GitHub                        (7)
     invite-teammates      Invite teammates              #3898
     geometry-kernel       Geometry kernel               #3902
     ...
   Closed on GitHub - would mark complete here                   (2)
     export-csv            Export to CSV                 #3877
   Not on GitHub yet - would be created                          (3)
     audit-log             Audit log                     --
   On GitHub only - not part of this plan                        (4)
     ...                                              (not synced)

                                          [Sync 12 issues]  [Cancel]
```

## Rules

- **Issues only.** Ref, title, GitHub number. No files, no code, no body diffs.
- Every bucket is visible before the action fires — including `remote_only`, which is listed but **not** synced, so the user can see what is being left alone.
- The action is explicit and counted (`Sync 12 issues`), never a bare "Sync".
- Result summary after apply, in `SeedDriftBanner`'s style — and it **names** what it skipped rather than reporting a bare count, for the reason called out at `AppBanners.tsx:706`.
- Dismissable; dismissal is per-run, not permanent.
- The preview calls the same diff function the CLI's `--dry-run` calls.

## Acceptance

- [ ] No sync fires without an explicit click.
- [ ] The list renders all four buckets with counts, and renders issues only.
- [ ] An empty diff renders no banner at all.
- [ ] The banner is keyboard-reachable and announced — a11y epic #2725 conventions (`announce()` / `LiveRegion`).
- [ ] Render + interaction tests, including the empty-diff and apply-result paths.
